هذا المستند يختص بعمل الصيانة الدورية لطلمبة

 المهندس/أحمد مصطفى الصباغ بتاريخ 14 يونيو 2003 
 وتمت المراسلات الاليكترونية خلال الانترنت بمساعدة المهندس/ 
 محمد سليم سالمان

وقد تم تنفيذه بناءً على الخبرة السابقة بمعرفة السيد المهندس / أحمد مصطفى

sections.text: قطع الغيار التي يمكن تغييرها حسب الحالة:

rows:
اعمل 
 تصبينة للبلنكو أو الترفل استعداداً لعملية رفع الطلمبة.

اعزل 
 الطلمبة كهربياً وميكانيكياً وإخراج المفتاح ووضع كارت تحذير 
 عليه.
ضع الطلمبة على دكم خشب على تزجة.
فك البلية الأمامية والخلفية ومراجعتها ومراجعة الحشو.
قياس خلوص الريشة مع الجزء الثابت وتدوينه.

الكشف الداخلي على حالة الريش والأجزاء الثابتة وتغيير ما 
 يلزم.

اعمل 
 روديه لبلف الطرد وإعادة الدورة.

بعد الكشف والتأكد من الحالة يتم التغيير حسب الحالة ويتم 
 التجميع بطريقة عكسية.

بعد تمام الإصلاح وإعادة التركيب يتم التشغيل والاطمئنان على 
 الحالة من حيث:

- الإهتزاز - ضغط وكمية الطرد - أمبير 
 تشغيل الموتور
 ارتفاع درجة
 حرارة الكراسي 
 وذلك طبقاً لمنحنيات الأداء

sections_en.text: This document covers the periodic maintenance of the (Clean Drain Tank) C.D.T pump. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003, and the electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.

It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, Technical Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.

Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment and use a helmet, safety shoes, ear muffs and gloves.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge and suction valves and the bearing cooling valve.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge valve.
Helmet and safety shoes
Chain block or Tirfor and its accessories (wire ropes and locks).
Complete tool set: wrenches of all types, open-end, ring and Allen keys.
Vernier caliper and dial caliper, 8-inch puller and feeler gauge, tazga and wooden blocks.

sections_en.text: Spare parts that may be changed as required:
Work steps to be carried out

rows: Rig the chain block or Tirfor in preparation for lifting the pump.
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically, take the switch out and place a warning card on it.
Undo the pump suction and discharge bolts.
Place the pump on wooden blocks on a tazga.
Dismantle the front and rear bearings, check them and check the packing.
Undo 8 studs for assembling the pump.
Measure the clearance of the impeller with the stationary part and record it.
Internal inspection of the condition of the impellers and stationary parts, and replace as necessary.
Replace the suction and discharge gaskets.
Reseat the discharge valve and restore the circuit.
After inspection and verifying the condition, replace as required and reassemble in reverse order.
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of:

- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
Bearing temperature rise
in accordance with the performance curves

Introduction
This document covers the periodic maintenance of the (Clean Drain Tank) C.D.T pump. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003, and the electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.
It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, Technical Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.
Safety precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, stating the industrial safety category
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, stating the industrial safety category
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment and use a helmet, safety shoes, ear muffs and gloves.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge and suction valves and the bearing cooling valve.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge valve.
Tools, instruments and equipment used
Helmet and safety shoes
Helmet and safety shoes
Chain block or Tirfor and its accessories (wire ropes and locks).
Complete tool set: wrenches of all types, open-end, ring and Allen keys.
Vernier caliper and dial caliper, 8-inch puller and feeler gauge, tazga and wooden blocks.
Spare parts that may be changed as required:

Work steps to be carried out
Open the work order. | 1
Disconnect the pump. | 2
Rig the chain block or Tirfor in preparation for lifting the pump. | 3
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically, take the switch out and place a warning card on it. | 4
Undo the pump suction and discharge bolts. | 5
Undo the pump base bolts. | 6
Undo the coupling bolt. | 7
Place the pump on wooden blocks on a tazga. | 8
Dismantle the front and rear bearings, check them and check the packing. | 9
Undo 8 studs for assembling the pump. | 10
Dismantle the pump stages | 11
Measure the clearance of the impeller with the stationary part and record it. | 12
Internal inspection of the condition of the impellers and stationary parts, and replace as necessary. | 13
Replace the pump O-rings. | 14
Replace the suction and discharge gaskets. | 15
Reseat the discharge valve and restore the circuit. | 16
After inspection and verifying the condition, replace as required and reassemble in reverse order. | 17
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of: | 18
- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
Bearing temperature rise
in accordance with the performance curves |
